title: Case Output Latch — busy_bit Undriven in Unhandled States
bug_signature: VCS-WARNING: Latch inferred for 'busy_bit'; IDLE and ERROR states leave busy_bit undriven
expected_root_cause: The always_comb case statement has no default or prior assignment for busy_bit; any state other than RUN or PAUSE leaves busy_bit without a driver, causing synthesis to infer a latch that holds the last known value.
fix_replacement:
always_comb begin
  busy_bit = 1'b0;  // Default before case — no latch
  case (state)
    RUN:   busy_bit = 1'b1;
    PAUSE: busy_bit = 1'b0;
  endcase
end
description: The case statement drives busy_bit for RUN and PAUSE but has no default; in IDLE and ERROR states busy_bit is undriven, synthesis infers a latch to preserve the last RUN or PAUSE value.
failure_log: VCS-WARNING: Latch inferred for 'busy_bit'; IDLE and ERROR states leave busy_bit undriven
success_log: busy_bit=0 in IDLE and ERROR. No latch warnings in synthesis.
